domains.objective: understand how public capital markets value the target company's business model, technology, and sector

process.description: understand core attributes of the company
requirements: business model must be clearly classified (e.g. marketplace, SaaS, B2B)
technology must include name, description, and general how it works
companies should be in similar region OR relevant market
must have exposure to similar technology
include mix of companies (not just leaders)

process.description: retrieve financial metrics from public sources
requirements: include revenue growth rate when available
track trends over time for each company

process.description: analyze how the public market values the sector
interpretation_rules: increasing multiples indicate rising market confidence

success_criteria: company characterized across business model, technology, and industry
financial metrics collected for most comparables

invalid_if: only tangential overlap (e.g. both use AI)

comparables_constraints: must share core product function (not just same broad category)
exclude large tech companies unless directly comparable at product level
exclude marketplaces unless business model matches target
grounding_enforcement: every numerical value must be traceable to a source
every company comparison must match technology and business model
do not infer product features unless explicitly extracted
if data is missing, mark as unknown instead of filling

investment_recommendation_allowed_only_i: at least 70% financial data coverage across comparables
clear company characterization confirmed from source

common_failures: using large tech companies as lazy comparables
confusing feature overlap with product overlap

domains.objective: assess how novel and competitive the target company's technology is

process.description: map the technology space using patent data

requirements: identify progression of ideas and improvements

process.description: evaluate how crowded or unique the space is
interpretation_rules: high patent volume indicates crowded space and lower entry angle
low patent volume indicates niche or early-stage technology
recent surge in patents indicates emerging trend
lack of recent patents may indicate stagnation

success_criteria: risk signal derived from patent landscape
technology_evaluation_axes: position in stack (infrastructure vs tool vs application layer)
grounding_enforcement: do not infer technical capabilities without explicit evidence
separate claimed functionality from verified functionality
avoid generic AI descriptions without mechanism-level detail
common_failures: treating all AI systems as equivalent
focusing on surface-level features instead of underlying mechanism
assuming novelty without patent or technical evidence
overgeneralizing from known big tech capabilities

novelty_assessment_allowed_only_if: patent landscape or equivalent evidence analyzed
technology mechanism understood at a high level
